about: Bills coded to the alignment questions (public/questions.json): {question id: {bill id (congress-type-number, as in the bill index): [side index, why]}}. A bill is coded only when it is clearly on one side of the question; procedural measures (rules for considering a bill), budget resolutions, large packages where the question is one provision among many, and bills that apply to a single territory are left out. Each was read from its titles and the Congressional Research Service's summary (scripts/question-bills.mjs lists the candidates).
